{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keep highest sample_seq
df = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Remove QC-failure rows
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Correct batch B values
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Compute response rates by arm and severity
response_rates = df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().reset_index()
response_rates = response_rates.pivot(index='arm', columns='severity', values='responded')
response_rates.columns.name = None

# Raw response rates
treatment_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
raw_diff = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Overall severity distribution
severity_dist = df['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Adjusted response rates using direct standardisation
adjusted_treatment = (response_rates.loc['treatment'] * severity_dist).sum()
adjusted_control = (response_rates.loc['control'] * severity_dist).sum()
adjusted_diff = adjusted_treatment - adjusted_control

# Print all required values explicitly
print("\nRaw response rate - treatment:", treatment_response_rate)
print("Raw response rate - control:", control_response_rate)
print("Raw difference in proportions (treatment - control):", raw_diff)

print("\nAdjusted response rate - treatment:", adjusted_treatment)
print("Adjusted response rate - control:", adjusted_control)
print("Adjusted difference in proportions (treatment - control):", adjusted_diff)

print("\nOverall severity distribution (across both arms):")
print(severity_dist)

# Return the adjusted difference as the final answer
adjusted_diff"}
